messages:
mia: raising a weird failure from today's int4 canary. long-generation past ~32k tokens starts to diverge when we enable KV compaction.

devin: short summary? repro steps?

mia: repro is small. run deterministic seed against rwd-open-13b-int4 with --kv-compact. seq=65536. differences show up at token ~32768 exactly.

sam: 32768 boundary... sounds like a power-of-two wrap or an off-by-one in positional base. did we change RoPE handling when we compact indexes?

mia: looks like compaction remaps kv entries to new base index but we only store a compressed index, not the absolute position used for RoPE. when we re-apply cached keys, the rotary phase uses the wrong base.

irene: can you paste repro command + small log excerpt?

mia: sure:
```bash
python tools/repro_long_kv.py --model rwd-open-13b-int4 --seq 65536 --seed 42 --kv-compact --save-logs /tmp/longkv.log
```
logs:
```
INFO  kv_compact: dropping 16384 entries, remapping base_idx 32768 -> 0
DEBUG compute_qkv: query[0:16] hash=0x9fa3
DEBUG apply_cached: restored_kv.base_pos=0 expected_abs_pos=32768
WARN  rope_phase_mismatch at abs_pos=32768 delta_phase=0.7854
ERROR token_mismatch at pos=32769 expected=" the" got=" an"
```

devin: that warn is the smoking gun. if base_pos is set to 0 after compaction, RoPE uses pos=0..N instead of original 32768.. so phase offset is lost.

sam: previously we encoded absolute positions into KV metadata. i thought we removed that to save memory for int4. looks like that's the tradeoff we missed.

mia: also saw eval-bot spike on the long-context eval suite after enabling int4+compact on canary: ppl +12% and rouge -2.1 on long-doc benchmark.

eval-bot: long-context-regression: {"model":"rwd-open-13b-int4","kv_compact":true,"ppl_change":"+12%","rouge_l_change":"-2.1"} 

irene: thanks. proposed fixes?

devin: two routes: (A) keep absolute position metadata in KV entries (store as int32) so compaction remapping doesn't alter RoPE; (B) when compacting, write a delta-offset and keep the original abs_pos in a tiny header; (C) recompute RoPE on cache restore which is expensive. A or B preferred.

sam: PR sketch: preserve 'abs_pos' in kv entry and only compute remap for lookup. small perf/memory hit but correct. i can do a quick patch.

mia: +1 on PR. short-term mitigation: disable --kv-compact for int4 canaries until patch.

devin: can we add a smoke test that forces a compact at several boundaries (16k, 32k, 48k) and runs token-level diff?

sam: yes. i'll add a unit that seeds at those boundaries and asserts exact token match between cold run and cached run. test loc: tests/kv/test_compaction_rope.py

irene: deploy-bot — please abort canary rollout for rwd-open-13b-int4 in eu-west-1 and flag the build.

deploy-bot: aborting canary rwd-open-13b-int4 eu-west-1 (canary id: c-2026-07-13-08). reason: long-context regression detected by eng-ml. :warning:

mia: opened PR #3124 with change to keep abs_pos on KV entries and added smoke test. linking logs and perf.

sam: will run perf baseline: memory delta expected ~+1.6% per kv entry on int4. allocate numbers in PR.

devin: also add a test to eval harness that runs long-context evals with kv_compact on/off to catch regressions in CI (we currently test short windows only).

mia: noted. i'll add to shiproom checklist for model bring-ups: long-context smoke + kv integrity check.

irene: great. timeline?

sam: pushing a patch for review today, aim to have canary re-run by EOD tomorrow if green.

devin: thanks all. huge props to @mia for catching the exact boundary. saved us from a silent quality regression. :tada:

mia: thanks! i'll post follow-ups after the canary re-run with updated eval-bot numbers.
